content: LangGraph orchestrates stateful workflows using nodes, edges and shared state. It supports checkpointing, streaming, human approval and durable execution. It is suitable for controlled enterprise workflows.
CrewAI coordinates specialized agents through roles, tasks and crews. Flows provide event-driven orchestration, state management and persistence for production applications.
AutoGen supports conversational multi-agent collaboration and message-based execution. The project is archived and Microsoft recommends Microsoft Agent Framework for new implementations.
Claude Agent SDK provides an autonomous agent loop, built-in tools, MCP integration, sessions, permission controls, hooks and usage monitoring.
